title: Referral program after legal
transcript:
[00:00] Rafael: Referral program. The landing page is built, the reward logic is tested.
[00:06] Sienna: Fifty dollars credit for the referrer, a free month for the new account.
[00:12] Tomas: And the cash option for partners. That's the part people actually asked for.
[00:18] Rafael: Right. So we launch the referral program once legal is done.
[00:23] Sienna: Makes sense. I'll have the launch email ready so we can go the same day.
[00:30] Tomas: I'll keep the partner sign-up form hidden until then.
[00:34] Rafael: Sienna, can you also brief support on the credit rules?
[00:39] Sienna: Yes, I'll do a short doc for them.
[00:43] Tomas: One thing. Do we cap referrals per account?
[00:47] Rafael: Ten per month. It's already in the reward logic.
[00:51] Tomas: Good.
[00:55] Rafael: OK. Thanks.
